verdict.rationale: Paxos documents which stablecoins it accepts for payments (PYUSD, USDC, USDP) and names its own issued assets (USDP, PAXG, PYUSD, USDG). Chain coverage is described only vaguely as "multiple blockchains", with no named networks, and USDT is never mentioned. Missing for 10: named supported blockchain networks per asset, USDT support, a consolidated asset/chain support matrix, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, the platform documents which stablecoins and chains it supports — USDC, USDT and peers across multiple named networks — so I can match what my customers actually hold

citations.quote: Accept PYUSD, USDC and USDP payments via on-chain transfers.
USD and Paxos-issued stablecoins only** (USDP, PAXG, PYUSD, USDG)
Available on multiple blockchains, PYUSD offers near-instant global settlements
